name: KrishnaDas GST Invoice for India
author: krishnadas8119

sections.description:
KrishnaDas GST Invoice for India helps WooCommerce stores generate professional GST invoices for Indian customers.

The plugin automatically creates printable tax invoices with GST details including:

  • GST invoice number
  • Company GSTIN
  • Billing information
  • Product tax breakdown
  • CGST / SGST / IGST support
  • Invoice print option
  • Customer invoice download
  • Thank you page invoice button
  • WooCommerce order integration

Perfect for Indian WooCommerce stores needing GST-compliant invoices.

Features

  • Generate GST invoices for WooCommerce orders
  • Customer invoice download button
  • Thank you page invoice download
  • Admin invoice download
  • Automatic invoice numbering
  • GSTIN support
  • CGST / SGST / IGST calculation
  • Printable invoice layout
  • HSN/SAC support
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • Translation ready
  • WordPress coding standards followed
  • HPOS compatible
  • WooCommerce My Account invoice downloads
  • GST-compliant invoice numbering
  • Custom company details and GSTIN

Documentation

Documentation and support:

https://hmsmanager.com/kd-gst-invoice-india/

Visit the plugin website for setup instructions, screenshots, FAQs, and support resources.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress plugins screen
  3. Go to WooCommerce → GST Invoice India
  4. Configure GST details
  5. Save settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required for this plugin.

Does it support GST invoices for India?

Yes. The plugin is specially built for Indian GST invoice requirements.

Can customers download invoices?

Yes. Customers can download invoices from:
– My Account orders
– WooCommerce thank you page

Does it support CGST and SGST?

Yes. The plugin supports:
– CGST
– SGST
– IGST

Can I print invoices?

Yes. Printable invoice view is included.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
